description: Everything oracle/indexer/oracle.py replaces (design FID-1). Like oracle/lower/replacements.json it is a separate list from oracle/mocks.json on purpose: the digest of that list is the version every golden trace records. The oracle records no trace; its answers are rules/v0_32/testdata/vllm_indexer_kv_dtype.json, regenerated and compared in CI.

replacements.how: dsa_indexer_uses_fp4 asks the platform two questions: is_rocm(), answered False (the table is for CUDA), and is_device_capability_family(100), answered from the case (true for family 100, false for 90). The ROCm branch is never run.

a namespace holding attention_config, whose value is an AttentionConfig class made of the one method vLLM defines for it, resolve_indexer_kv_dtype, taken from the source as written, with indexer_kv_dtype set from the case. The rest of AttentionConfig, a pydantic dataclass whose module imports the attention backends, is not built.
a type name dsa_indexer_uses_fp4's signature mentions; annotations are evaluated when the definition runs.

replacements.symbol: self (the DeepseekV4Indexer the record-width statement reads)
replacements.how: the statement `if self.use_fp4_kv: ... else: ...` of DeepseekV4Indexer.__init__ and the assignment `self.quant_block_size = 128` before it are run as written over a namespace holding use_fp4_kv (from the case's resolution) and head_dim (128, the catalog graphs' d_h of the indexer). The rest of the constructor builds layers and is not run.
